name: elias-mods
description: Elias's personal Claude Code mods for the Desktop app: a shared band above the prompt that each feature adds a row to

barometer.title: Context barometer
barometer.description: Show context fill and plan limits in the band above the prompt

handoff_at.title: Handoff threshold
handoff_at.description: Context percent at which the barometer offers a Handoff button

skill_route.title: Skill route
skill_route.description: Show the skills loaded this turn and warn on supporting-only loads

skill_guard_refuse.title: Skill guard refuses
skill_guard_refuse.description: Refuse a supporting-only skill loaded with no primary skill this turn, instead of only warning

answer_sheet.title: Grilling answer sheet
answer_sheet.description: Offer a pane to answer grilling rounds question by question
